在原有地貌／小模型粗排候選之外，補入 P90–P10 起伏接近的地球窗格；兩側以: In addition to the original landform/small-model coarse-ranked candidates, Earth windows with similar P90–P10 relief are added; both sides are rebuilt at the same metric grid spacing, aligned over eight rotations/reflections, each has its median elevation subtracted, and they are ranked by unscaled elevation-difference RMSE. The original normalized-shape mode can still be selected; overlays can switch between a shared metric color scale or separate normalization, and list the metric relief and RMSE values. The metric error is only a DEM geometric difference, not geological or analog accuracy. The lunar research page also offers an optional conservative surface-evidence filter: windows that simultaneously meet ≥80% alluvium on the state map, ≥80% shrubland in NLCD, and ≤5% barren land are excluded from the top five displayed; Mars is not filtered by default, to avoid discarding potentially useful alluvial landforms. Among the 180 top-five pure-geometry results for the 36 lunar queries in the eight-area development set, 11 triggered this double conflict; after filtering, every query still has five results. This is a rule effect, not material or analog accuracy; the state map and land cover are coarse in scale, and passing the filter does not prove exposed rock.
在完整同尺度索引上計算條件，不只篩最後五筆。條件是使用者設定的類比目標，不能解讀: Conditions are computed over the full same-scale index, not just used to filter the final five results. The conditions are analog targets set by the user and must not be interpreted as the system having identified sandy terrain on the Moon/Mars.
在月球或火星上選中心，設定 20、40 或 80 km 的方形範圍。每個格點讀取: Pick a center on the Moon or Mars and set a square extent of 20, 40 or 80 km. Elevation is read at each grid point, in meters.
在未查看模型排名之前，固定 NASA 類比脈絡中的 Lava Beds 火山區與: Before looking at any model ranking, Earth coordinates were fixed for two sites from NASA analog contexts: the Lava Beds volcanic area and the Pilot Valley salt flat. USGS 1 m bare-earth elevation for each was cropped to 3 km/2 m and converted into 200/500/1000 m candidates at Moon–Earth 5 m and Mars–Earth 20 m; the 2014 landform signatures and the trained TinyMorphEncoder weights remain unchanged. Both sites exist only in a separate research folder and have not yet been added to the public search library, model training or tuning. The fixed coordinates for Kīlauea have no valid pixels in the selected 2017 3DEP layer; the failure record is retained and a USGS 2019 lidar source is being investigated separately.
在查看保留區排序前固定 Jezero 的八個查詢中心，每個中心各比較 200／5: Eight Jezero query centers were fixed before viewing the held-out rankings, and each center compares 200/500/1000 m windows. 3DEP elevation for two new Earth regions, Lava Beds and Pilot Valley, was rebuilt into a 4 m candidate library: the three scales have 1,680, 241 and 49 overlapping windows respectively. Reusing the frozen 2014 landform features and the 30,024-parameter TinyMorphEncoder, each of the two methods selects two items, plus one sampled control; each question has five items in shuffled order. The public packet has 24 questions and 120 pairs; methods and candidate locations appear only in the non-public answer key.

尚缺地球域驗證、DEM／影像／地質融合，以及未知類別與缺資料測試。正式搜尋仍使用: Earth-domain validation, DEM/image/geology fusion, and unknown-class and missing-data tests are still lacking. Production search still uses the existing terrain and regional-condition pipeline.
岩石材質相同、有水資源、適合建基地，或已確認為月／火星類比。火星遷移與跨天體候選: That the rock material is the same, that water resources exist, that the site is suitable for a base, or that it is a confirmed Moon/Mars analog. Mars transfer and cross-body candidates still require independent validation.
已固定月球六處、火星兩處各三尺度的 24 查詢／120 配對小尺度盲評包，使用擴: A small-scale blind-evaluation package of 24 queries/120 pairs has been fixed, covering six lunar and two Martian locations at three scales each, using the two-site Earth candidate pool from before Carrizozo was added, with the 2014 baseline, the small model, and control candidates shown in shuffled order. Human scoring has been cancelled; moreover, the existing sites have already been used in the research, so no cross-body accuracy or novel-site discovery rate can be claimed. Two new geographic holdout sites have been frozen and vectorized, and await independent labeling and evaluation.

扣除中位高度、依起伏縮放，保留山脊與盆地形狀；另把原始高差送入模型，避免忽略大小: Subtract the median height and scale by relief, preserving the shapes of ridges and basins; the raw height range is also fed into the model so differences in size are not ignored.
批次64個同來源窗格，τ = 0.1；正例為同一窗格影像與DEM。其他窗格是身份: Batches of 64 same-source windows, τ = 0.1; positives are the image and DEM of the same window. Other windows act as instance (in-batch) negatives, which does not mean their landforms or mission relevance are dissimilar.
找回原窗格的名次: Rank at which the original window is retrieved
把同尺度 DEM、中位正規化高程、坡度和曲率轉成 32×32×3 輸入，四層小卷: Same-scale DEM, median-normalized elevation, slope and curvature are converted into a 32×32×3 input, and four small convolutional layers output a 32-dimensional unit vector. Earth candidates are vectorized offline in advance; at query time, cosine similarity coarse-ranks the top 40 of the whole pool + the top 10 per site, followed by D4 fine ranking on true height difference or normalized shape, and regional de-duplication.

Human rating was cancelled under plan 12.11; no ratings are being recruited or collected, and there are no rating results to analyze. Acceptance instead relies on traceable public labels, model comparisons and automated operational tests; the existing data still do not support a cross-body analog accuracy. Mars uses only one site, Jezero, which was involved in development; there are also only two Earth held-out areas, so the results cannot be extrapolated to global terrain or prove rock material, caves or base safety.

目前只有八塊約 3 km 的地球候選區域；與小模型使用相同窗格，但沒有跨天體專家: There are currently only eight Earth candidate areas of about 3 km; they use the same windows as the small model, but there is no cross-body expert blind test to judge which ranking is better.
目前採 32 維向量的精確餘弦搜尋；小池資料尚不需要近似最近鄰索引。待地球範圍擴: Currently uses exact cosine search over 32-dimensional vectors; the small pool does not yet need an approximate nearest-neighbor index. Retrieval latency will be re-measured once Earth coverage expands.
目前的 3D 視圖用真實 DEM 生成網格，將有來源的月球或地球影像貼合於表面。: The current 3D view builds a mesh from real DEMs and drapes sourced lunar or Earth imagery onto the surface. Comparison mode uses the same horizontal and vertical meter scale on both sides and can switch between side-by-side, a co-located wireframe overlay, and per-cell relative height-difference coloring. The relative height difference is defined as Δh = (Earth elevation − Earth window median) − (Moon/Mars elevation − Moon/Mars window median), with colors clipped at the 90th percentile of |Δh|; it is a cross-site shape residual, not a measurement error at the same site. The 3D mesh is a sparse preview loaded on demand; the actual visual grid spacing is listed separately on the page and should not be misread as the full resolution of the original DEM. High-resolution results can open a standalone 3D mission scenario, where you click on the actual DEM mesh to place a NASA Apollo Lunar Module, the Perseverance rover or an HDU display model, and switch to the same vertical exaggeration. Each result can be downloaded as a Markdown site card that records the selection center, ranking, land-cover and climate sources, and limitations. The models only convey scale and layout concepts; there is no certification of bearing capacity, hazardous boulders, illumination or landing safety. Skyfall-GS multi-view 3D Gaussian Splatting and diffusion refinement have not yet been completed on this site; the textures in the 3D display do not take part in the current search ranking.

與八處 USGS 3DEP 1 m 裸地資料在同一 4 m 格網建索引：200: Indexed on the same 4 m grid together with eight USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth datasets: 200 m is 50×50 cells with 6,728 overlapping candidates; 500 m is 125×125 cells with 968; 1 km is 250×250 cells with 200. Each window has 55-dimensional geomorphon co-occurrence features and a 32-dimensional vector from the same frozen 30,024-parameter TinyMorphEncoder. Users can switch between the two coarse rankings, then fine-rank with D4 rotation/reflection on true height difference in meters or on relative shape. Geologic map, NLCD and NAIP NDVI evidence has been resampled to the exact center and box of each 4 m Earth candidate and is kept separate from the geometric ranking; the original map-sheet scale, 30 m class pixels and differing image years still limit material interpretation. The Earth 3D NAIP textures are also taken from the same candidate center.
